conventions.stars: unit rows/hp/ad are [1star,2star,3star,4star]; trait rows are [tier1..tierN] (index = ctx.tier, 0-based = active breakpoint); item rows [lv1..lv4] (items use index 0)
conventions.itemStats: hp flat, hpPct fraction of base max HP, ad fraction of base AD, ap flat points, as fraction of base AS, armor/mr flat, crit/critDmg/omnivamp/dmgAmp fractions, manaRegen per second
conventions.calcBaseline: tooltip values assume AP=100 (S=1), AD ratio 1, HealthMax = 1-star max HP, BasicAttackDamage = 1-star AD
conventions.calcOps: terms fold left to right from 0: add/multiply/override/divide; scaled term = coefficient[i] * (S(scaling) + preAdd[i]?); S(otherCalc) is recursive; i = star-1 (units) or tier-1 (traits)
conventions.nullStats: summons/plants may carry null hp/ad/armor/mr/as (no data anywhere): ctx.summon / the champion module must supply them; shop, form and pve units are fully populated (pve units without HP are dropped)
conventions.kinds: shop 65 | form (Lux_<trait>, NidaleeCougar, GnarBig; parent+variant set) | summon 12 | plant 3 (Elderwood_Stonebark/Lifebloom/Protector, see aliases.plants) | pve (TrainingDummy, PvE_*; legacy.vars = legacy ability variables)
conventions.itemModule: item.module = key of the module file to write, or null when the item is stat-only (engine applies item.stats); radiants point at their base item module and carry item.base
conventions.nullCalcValues: calcs with values:null depend on runtime state (stacks, gold) and have no tooltip baseline

ability.descZh: 向<TFTCurveTable row="AbilityCenterHexRange"/>格範圍內周圍有最多敵軍的位置發射靈魂炸彈，炸彈對<TFTCurveTable row="HexRadius"/>格範圍內的敵軍造成<TFTAttribute style="colorMagic" icon="icon.AP" attributeID="TFTCalculationAttributes.MagicDamageCalc1"/>魔法傷害，每遠離爆炸中心1格，傷害降低<TFTCurveTable row="HexPercentDamageFalloffTooltip" format="percent"/>。
ability.descEn: Launch a spirit bomb at the location within <TFTCurveTable row="AbilityCenterHexRange"/> hexes that has the most surrounding enemies. It deals <TFTAttribute style="colorMagic" icon="icon.AP" attributeID="TFTCalculationAttributes.MagicDamageCalc1"/> magic damage to enemies in a <TFTCurveTable row="HexRadius"/> hex radius, reduced by <TFTCurveTable row="HexPercentDamageFalloffTooltip" format="percent"/> per hex away from the epicenter.

ability.descZh:
<Bright>幻化者</><TFTAttribute style="colorPhysical" icon="icon.AD"/><Bright>：</>向目標投擲大量苦無，造成<TFTAttribute style="colorPhysical" icon="icon.AD, icon.AP" attributeID="TFTCalculationAttributes.PhysicalDamageCalc1"/>物理傷害。若目標處於<keyword>燃燒</>狀態，則額外造成<TFTAttribute style="colorPhysical" icon="icon.AD" attributeID="TFTCalculationAttributes.PhysicalDamageCalc2"/>傷害。

<dim>幻化者</><TFTAttribute icon="icon.AP"></><dim>：若技能造成擊殺，則再施放一次。</>
ability.descEn:
<Bright>Adaptor </><TFTAttribute style="colorPhysical" icon="icon.AD"/><Bright>:</> Throw a volley of kunai at the target, dealing <TFTAttribute style="colorPhysical" icon="icon.AD, icon.AP" attributeID="TFTCalculationAttributes.PhysicalDamageCalc1"/> physical damage. If the target is <keyword>Burning</>, deal an additional <TFTAttribute style="colorPhysical" icon="icon.AD" attributeID="TFTCalculationAttributes.PhysicalDamageCalc2"/> damage.

<dim>Adaptor </><TFTAttribute icon="icon.AP"></><dim>: If the Ability kills, cast it again.</>

ability.descZh:
<Bright>幻化者</><TFTAttribute style="colorMagic" icon=" icon.AP"/><Bright>：</>向目標投擲大量苦無，造成<TFTAttribute style="colorMagic" icon="icon.AP" attributeID="TFTCalculationAttributes.MagicDamageCalc1"/>魔法傷害。若目標為坦克，則傷害增加到<TFTCurveTable row="TankDamageMultiplierAP" format="percentminusone"/>。若目標陣亡，則再次施放，效果變為<TFTCurveTable row="RecastDamageReduction" format="percent"/>。

<Rules>幻化者</><TFTAttribute icon="icon.ad"/><Rules>：對處於燃燒狀態的敵軍造成額外傷害。</>
ability.descEn:
<Bright>Adaptor </><TFTAttribute style="colorMagic" icon=" icon.AP"/><Bright>:</> Throw a volley of kunai at the target, dealing <TFTAttribute style="colorMagic" icon="icon.AP" attributeID="TFTCalculationAttributes.MagicDamageCalc1"/> magic damage, increased by <TFTCurveTable row="TankDamageMultiplierAP" format="percentminusone"/> if they're a Tank. If the target dies, cast again at <TFTCurveTable row="RecastDamageReduction" format="percent"/> effectiveness.

<Rules>Adaptor </><TFTAttribute icon="icon.ad"/><Rules>: Bonus damage to Burning enemies.</>

ability.descZh: 咆哮，回復<TFTAttribute style="colorHealth" icon="icon.Health, icon.AP" attributeID="TFTCalculationAttributes.HealthCalc1"/>生命，清除限制效果，並使生命百分比最低的兩名友軍回復<TFTAttribute style="colorHealth" icon="icon.AP" attributeID="TFTCalculationAttributes.HealthCalc2"/>生命。接著猛擊當前目標，造成<TFTAttribute style="colorMagic" icon="icon.AP" attributeID="TFTCalculationAttributes.MagicDamageCalc1"/>魔法傷害並使其暈眩<TFTCurveTable row="StunDuration"/>秒。
ability.descEn: Roar, restoring <TFTAttribute style="colorHealth" icon="icon.Health, icon.AP" attributeID="TFTCalculationAttributes.HealthCalc1"/> Health, cleansing disables, and healing the two lowest percent Health allies for <TFTAttribute style="colorHealth" icon="icon.AP" attributeID="TFTCalculationAttributes.HealthCalc2"/>. Then slam the current target, dealing <TFTAttribute style="colorMagic" icon="icon.AP" attributeID="TFTCalculationAttributes.MagicDamageCalc1"/> magic damage and Stunning them for <TFTCurveTable row="StunDuration"/> seconds.

ability.descZh:
降下<TFTCurveTable row="NumMoonshards"/>塊月華碎片，每塊造成<TFTAttribute style="colorMagic" icon="icon.AP" attributeID="TFTCalculationAttributes.MagicDamageCalc1"/>魔法傷害，由<TFTCurveTable row="NumEnemies"/>名最靠近的敵軍平均分攤。

若處於滿月狀態，則改為月亮墜落到盤面上，所有敵軍平均分攤<TFTAttribute style="colorMagic" icon="icon.AP" attributeID="TFTCalculationAttributes.MagicDamageCalc2"/>魔法傷害。
ability.descEn:
Rain <TFTCurveTable row="NumMoonshards"/> moonshards split among the <TFTCurveTable row="NumEnemies"/> nearest enemies, dealing <TFTAttribute style="colorMagic" icon="icon.AP" attributeID="TFTCalculationAttributes.MagicDamageCalc1"/> magic damage each.

If the moon is full, instead crash it onto the board, dealing <TFTAttribute style="colorMagic" icon="icon.AP" attributeID="TFTCalculationAttributes.MagicDamageCalc2"/> magic damage split among all enemies.

ability.descZh:
<Bright>被動：</>每秒回復<TFTAttribute style="colorHealth" icon="icon.AP, icon.Health" attributeID="TFTCalculationAttributes.HealthCalc1"/>生命，並對<TFTCurveTable row="PassiveHexRadius"/>格內的敵軍造成<TFTAttribute style="colorMagic" icon="icon.AP" attributeID="TFTCalculationAttributes.MagicDamageCalc1"/>魔法傷害。

<Bright>主動：</>對<TFTCurveTable row="BigHexRadius"/>格內的敵軍造成<TFTAttribute style="colorMagic" icon="icon.AP" attributeID="TFTCalculationAttributes.MagicDamageCalc3"/>魔法傷害，並暈眩<TFTCurveTable row="StunDuration"/>秒，如目標處於<Keyword>燃燒</>狀態，則增加到<TFTAttribute style="" icon="" attributeID="TFTCalculationAttributes.GenericCalc1" precision="1"/>秒。

<Rules>燃燒：每秒造成相當於目標最大生命一定百分比的真實傷害。</>
ability.descEn:
<Bright>Passive:</> Every second, restore <TFTAttribute style="colorHealth" icon="icon.AP, icon.Health" attributeID="TFTCalculationAttributes.HealthCalc1"/> Health and deal <TFTAttribute style="colorMagic" icon="icon.AP" attributeID="TFTCalculationAttributes.MagicDamageCalc1"/> magic damage to enemies within <TFTCurveTable row="PassiveHexRadius"/> hex.

<Bright>Active:</> Deal <TFTAttribute style="colorMagic" icon="icon.AP" attributeID="TFTCalculationAttributes.MagicDamageCalc3"/> magic damage to enemies within <TFTCurveTable row="BigHexRadius"/> hexes and Stun them for <TFTCurveTable row="StunDuration"/> seconds, increased to <TFTAttribute style="" icon="" attributeID="TFTCalculationAttributes.GenericCalc1" precision="1"/> seconds if the target is <Keyword>Burning</>.

<Rules>Burn: Deals a percent of the target’s max Health as true damage every second.</>

ability.descZh:
裝備月鐮槍刃，<TFTCurveTable row="Duration"/>秒內揮擊目標<TFTAttribute style="colorStat" icon="icon.AS" attributeID="TFTCalculationAttributes.GenericCalc1"/>次，每次造成<TFTAttribute style="colorPhysical" icon="icon.AD" attributeID="TFTCalculationAttributes.PhysicalDamageCalc1"/>物理傷害。

狂襲結束後，發出衝擊波，造成<TFTAttribute style="colorPhysical" icon="icon.AD, icon.AP" attributeID="TFTCalculationAttributes.PhysicalDamageCalc2"/>物理傷害，由2格範圍內所有敵軍分攤。
ability.descEn:
Equip Severum and swipe the target <TFTAttribute style="colorStat" icon="icon.AS" attributeID="TFTCalculationAttributes.GenericCalc1"/> times over <TFTCurveTable row="Duration"/> seconds, each dealing <TFTAttribute style="colorPhysical" icon="icon.AD" attributeID="TFTCalculationAttributes.PhysicalDamageCalc1"/> physical damage. 

After the onslaught finishes, fire a blast that deals <TFTAttribute style="colorPhysical" icon="icon.AD, icon.AP" attributeID="TFTCalculationAttributes.PhysicalDamageCalc2"/> physical damage split among all enemies in a 2 Hex radius.

ability.descZh:
朝最多敵軍的直線射出一支箭，造成<TFTAttribute attributeID="TFTCalculationAttributes.PhysicalDamageCalc1" style="colorPhysical" icon="icon.AD"/>物理傷害，每命中一名敵軍，傷害降低<TFTCurveTable row="DamageFalloffPerEnemy" format="percent"/> (最低<TFTCurveTable row="MinDamagePercent" format="percent"/>)。如果沒有命中敵人，返還<TFTCurveTable row="ManaRefund" format="percent"/>消耗魔力。

箭矢會留下軌跡，持續<TFTCurveTable row="RiftDuration"/>秒，每秒對範圍內的敵軍造成<TFTAttribute attributeID="TFTCalculationAttributes.PhysicalDamageCalc2" style="colorPhysical" icon="icon.AD, icon.AP"/> + <TFTCurveTable row="MaxHealthDamagePerSecond" style="colorPhysical" format="percent"/>最大生命的物理傷害，以及<TFTCurveTable row="ChillPercent"/>%<Keyword>緩速</>。

<Rules>緩速：降低攻速</>
ability.descEn:
Fire an arrow through the most enemies in a line that deals <TFTAttribute attributeID="TFTCalculationAttributes.PhysicalDamageCalc1" style="colorPhysical" icon="icon.AD"/> physical damage, reduced by <TFTCurveTable row="DamageFalloffPerEnemy" format="percent"/> per enemy hit (minimum <TFTCurveTable row="MinDamagePercent" format="percent"/>). If no enemies are hit refund <TFTCurveTable row="ManaRefund" format="percent"/> of mana spent.

The arrow leaves a trail for <TFTCurveTable row="RiftDuration"/> seconds that deals <TFTAttribute attributeID="TFTCalculationAttributes.PhysicalDamageCalc2" style="colorPhysical" icon="icon.AD, icon.AP"/> + <TFTCurveTable row="MaxHealthDamagePerSecond" style="colorPhysical" format="percent"/> max Health physical damage per second to enemies within and <TFTCurveTable row="ChillPercent"/>% <Keyword>Slows</> them.

<Rules>Slow: Reduce Attack Speed</>

ability.descZh: 增加<TFTCurveTable row="AttackSpeed" format="percentminusone" style="colorStat"/>攻速，且接下來的<TFTCurveTable row="NumAttacks"/>次普攻召喚<TFTCurveTable row="SoldiersToSpawn"/>名士兵。普攻改為指揮士兵進行攻擊，每次造成<TFTAttribute style="colorMagic" icon="icon.AP" attributeID="TFTCalculationAttributes.MagicDamageCalc1"/>魔法傷害。
ability.descEn: Gain <TFTCurveTable row="AttackSpeed" format="percentminusone" style="colorStat"/> Attack Speed and summon <TFTCurveTable row="SoldiersToSpawn"/> soldiers for the next <TFTCurveTable row="NumAttacks"/> attacks. These attacks are replaced by commands which direct each soldier to deal <TFTAttribute style="colorMagic" icon="icon.AP" attributeID="TFTCalculationAttributes.MagicDamageCalc1"/> magic damage per attack.

<bright>主動：</>增加<TFTCurveTable row="FrenzyADPercent" style="colorStat" format="percent"/>物攻，持續<TFTCurveTable row="Duration"/>秒。在此期間無視<TFTAttribute attributeID="TFTCalculationAttributes.GenericCalc1" style="colorStat" icon="icon.AP" format="percent"/>物防。

ability.descZh: 獲得<TFTAttribute attributeID="TFTCalculationAttributes.ShieldCalc1" style="colorStat"/>護盾，持續<TFTCurveTable row="ShieldDuration"/>秒，並向2格範圍內的敵軍發射<TFTCurveTable row="NumOrbs"/>顆月光法球，每顆造成<TFTAttribute style="colorMagic" icon="icon.AP" attributeID="TFTCalculationAttributes.MagicDamageCalc1"/>魔法傷害。

ability.descZh:
<bright>被動：</>普攻範圍內的隨機敵軍並造成流血效果，在<TFTCurveTable row="BleedDuration"/>秒內造成<TFTAttribute attributeID="TFTCalculationAttributes.PhysicalDamageCalc1" style="colorPhysical" icon="icon.AD" precision="0"/>物理傷害。每次普攻有<TFTAttribute attributeID="TFTCalculationAttributes.GenericCalc1" style="colorStat" icon="icon.AP" format="percent" precision="0"/>機率改為造成<TFTCurveTable row="SpinningAxeDamageRatio" format="percentminusone" style="colorStat"/>額外物理傷害並附加<TFTCurveTable row="SpinningAxeBleedStacks"/>層流血。

<bright>主動：</>朝流血層數最多的敵軍擲出兩把巨斧。對命中的敵軍造成<TFTAttribute attributeID="TFTCalculationAttributes.PhysicalDamageCalc3" style="colorPhysical" icon="icon.AD" precision="0"/>物理傷害，並消耗其流血層數，立即造成剩餘傷害。飛斧回程時，對命中的敵軍造成<TFTAttribute attributeID="TFTCalculationAttributes.GenericCalc2" style="colorPhysical" icon="icon.AD" precision="0"/>物理傷害，如果沒有命中敵人，返還<TFTCurveTable row="ManaRefund" format="percent"/>消耗魔力。
ability.descEn:
<bright>Passive:</> Attacks target random enemies in range and apply a bleed that deals <TFTAttribute attributeID="TFTCalculationAttributes.PhysicalDamageCalc1" style="colorPhysical" icon="icon.AD" precision="0"/> physical damage over <TFTCurveTable row="BleedDuration"/> seconds. Every attack has a <TFTAttribute attributeID="TFTCalculationAttributes.GenericCalc1" style="colorStat" icon="icon.AP" format="percent" precision="0"/> chance to deal <TFTCurveTable row="SpinningAxeDamageRatio" format="percentminusone" style="colorStat"/> bonus physical damage and apply <TFTCurveTable row="SpinningAxeBleedStacks"/> bleeds instead.

<bright>Active:</> Throw two giant axes towards the enemy with the most bleeds. Deal <TFTAttribute attributeID="TFTCalculationAttributes.PhysicalDamageCalc3" style="colorPhysical" icon="icon.AD" precision="0"/> physical damage to enemies hit and consume their bleed, instantly dealing the remaining damage. The axes then return, dealing <TFTAttribute attributeID="TFTCalculationAttributes.GenericCalc2" style="colorPhysical" icon="icon.AD" precision="0"/> physical damage to enemies hit. If no enemies are hit refund <TFTCurveTable row="ManaRefund" format="percent"/> of mana spent.

<Bright>龍之吐息：</>對最多敵軍的直線噴火，造成<TFTAttribute attributeID="TFTCalculationAttributes.PhysicalDamageCalc2" style="colorPhysical" icon="icon.AD, icon.AP"/>物理傷害，每穿過一名敵軍傷害減少<TFTCurveTable row="DamageReductionPerHit" format="percent"/> (最低<TFTCurveTable row="MinimumDamageThreshold" format="percent"/>)。點燃目標<TFTCurveTable row="IgniteDuration"/>秒。

<TFTConditionalStyle tag="Set18.Trait.Riftbeast.Selected" activeStyle="bright" inactiveStyle="dim">遠古巨龍增益：</><TFTConditionalStyle tag="Set18.Trait.Riftbeast.Selected" activeStyle="default" inactiveStyle="dim">對生命低於<TFTCurveTable row="TraitExecuteThreshold" format="percent"/>的敵軍造成傷害時，將其處決。</>

Replace this ability with Flame Breath and immediately cast it.

<Bright>Flame Breath:</>  Spew fire at the most enemies in a line through the target, dealing <TFTAttribute attributeID="TFTCalculationAttributes.PhysicalDamageCalc2" style="colorPhysical" icon="icon.AD, icon.AP"/> physical damage, reduced by <TFTCurveTable row="DamageReductionPerHit" format="percent"/> for each enemy it passes through (minimum <TFTCurveTable row="MinimumDamageThreshold" format="percent"/>.) <Bright>幻化者</><TFTAttribute style="colorPhysical" icon="icon.AD"/><Bright>：</>朝當前目標吐出1顆重型氣泡，氣泡會在命中第一位敵軍時爆炸，造成<TFTAttribute style="colorPhysical" icon="icon.AD, icon.AP" attributeID="TFTCalculationAttributes.PhysicalDamageCalc1"/>物理傷害，並<keyword>緩速</><TFTCurveTable row="SlowAmountAD"/>%，持續<TFTCurveTable row="SlowDurationAD"/>秒。對1格範圍內的敵軍造成<TFTAttribute style="colorPhysical" icon="icon.AD" attributeID="TFTCalculationAttributes.PhysicalDamageCalc2"/>物理傷害。

<dim>幻化者</><TFTAttribute icon="icon.ap"/><dim>：使命中的敵軍中毒，造成持續傷害。</>

<TFTConditionalStyle tag="Set18.Trait.Riftbeast.Selected" activeStyle="bright" inactiveStyle="dim">紫色增益：</><TFTConditionalStyle tag="Set18.Trait.Riftbeast.Selected" activeStyle="default" inactiveStyle="dim">啾吉每<TFTCurveTable row="TraitTimer"/>秒獲得</><TFTConditionalStyle tag="Set18.Trait.Riftbeast.Selected" activeStyle="colorStat" inactiveStyle="dim"><TFTCurveTable row="TraitTimedAD" format="percent"/></><TFTConditionalStyle tag="Set18.Trait.Riftbeast.Selected" activeStyle="default" inactiveStyle="dim">物攻。</>
ability.descEn:
<Bright>Adaptor </><TFTAttribute style="colorPhysical" icon="icon.AD"/><Bright>:</> Belch a heavy bubble at the current target exploding on the first enemy hit, dealing <TFTAttribute style="colorPhysical" icon="icon.AD, icon.AP" attributeID="TFTCalculationAttributes.PhysicalDamageCalc1"/> physical damage and <TFTCurveTable row="SlowAmountAD"/>% <keyword>Slows</> for <TFTCurveTable row="SlowDurationAD"/> seconds. Enemies within a 1 hex radius take <TFTAttribute style="colorPhysical" icon="icon.AD" attributeID="TFTCalculationAttributes.PhysicalDamageCalc2"/> physical damage.

<dim>Adaptor </><TFTAttribute icon="icon.ap"/><dim>: Poisons enemies hit, dealing damage over time.</>

<TFTConditionalStyle tag="Set18.Trait.Riftbeast.Selected" activeStyle="bright" inactiveStyle="dim">Purple Buff:</> <TFTConditionalStyle tag="Set18.Trait.Riftbeast.Selected" activeStyle="default" inactiveStyle="dim">Every <TFTCurveTable row="TraitTimer"/> seconds, Gromp gains</> <TFTConditionalStyle tag="Set18.Trait.Riftbeast.Selected" activeStyle="colorStat" inactiveStyle="dim"><TFTCurveTable row="TraitTimedAD" format="percent"/></> <TFTConditionalStyle tag="Set18.Trait.Riftbeast.Selected" activeStyle="default" inactiveStyle="dim">Attack Damage.</>

ability.descZh: 增加<TFTCurveTable style="colorStat" row="Resists"/>雙防，持續3秒，在持續時間內回復<TFTAttribute style="colorHealth" icon="icon.AP" attributeID="TFTCalculationAttributes.HealthCalc1"/> 生命。派出幽魂騎士攻擊最靠近的<TFTCurveTable row="NumEnemies"/>位敵軍，造成<TFTAttribute style="colorMagic" icon="icon.AP" attributeID="TFTCalculationAttributes.MagicDamageCalc1"/> 魔法傷害，並使其暈眩<TFTCurveTable row="StunDuration" style="colorStat"/>秒。
ability.descEn: Gain <TFTCurveTable style="colorStat" row="Resists"/> Armor and Magic Resist for 3 seconds and restore <TFTAttribute style="colorHealth" icon="icon.AP" attributeID="TFTCalculationAttributes.HealthCalc1"/> Health over the duration. Launch spectral riders at the <TFTCurveTable row="NumEnemies"/> nearest enemies, dealing <TFTAttribute style="colorMagic" icon="icon.AP" attributeID="TFTCalculationAttributes.MagicDamageCalc1"/> magic damage and Stunning them for <TFTCurveTable row="StunDuration" style="colorStat"/> seconds.

ability.descZh:
<bright>被動：</>此技能賦予的護盾可透過<Keyword>精準</>暴擊。

<bright>主動：</>賦予<TFTCurveTable row="NumAlliesToShield"/>名友軍<TFTAttribute attributeID="TFTCalculationAttributes.ShieldCalc1" icon="icon.AP, icon.DamageAmp" style="colorStat"/>護盾和<TFTCurveTable row="DamageAmpAmount" style="colorStat" format="percent"/>傷害增幅，持續<TFTCurveTable row="ShieldDuration"/>秒。接著，對其相鄰的敵軍造成<TFTAttribute attributeID="TFTCalculationAttributes.MagicDamageCalc1" style="colorMagic" icon="icon.AP"/>魔法傷害。施放技能<TFTCurveTable row="CastThreshold"/>次後，還會賦予目標<TFTCurveTable row="AttackSpeed" style="colorStat" format="percentminusone"/>可累加的攻速。
ability.descEn:
<bright>Passive:</> Shields from this Ability can critically strike with <Keyword>Precision</>. 

<bright>Active:</> Grant <TFTCurveTable row="NumAlliesToShield"/> allies <TFTAttribute attributeID="TFTCalculationAttributes.ShieldCalc1" icon="icon.AP, icon.DamageAmp" style="colorStat"/> Shield and <TFTCurveTable row="DamageAmpAmount" style="colorStat" format="percent"/> Damage Amp for <TFTCurveTable row="ShieldDuration"/> seconds. Then deal <TFTAttribute attributeID="TFTCalculationAttributes.MagicDamageCalc1" style="colorMagic" icon="icon.AP"/> magic damage to enemies adjacent to them. After casting <TFTCurveTable row="CastThreshold"/> times, also grant <TFTCurveTable row="AttackSpeed" style="colorStat" format="percentminusone"/> stacking Attack Speed to targets.

ability.descZh:
連結當前目標，在<TFTCurveTable row="TetherDuration"/>秒內造成<TFTAttribute style="colorMagic" icon="icon.AP" attributeID="TFTCalculationAttributes.MagicDamageCalc1"/>魔法傷害。之後釋放爆發能量，對<TFTCurveTable row="AoEHexRange"/>格範圍內所有敵軍造成<TFTAttribute style="colorMagic" icon="icon.AP" attributeID="TFTCalculationAttributes.MagicDamageCalc2"/>魔法傷害和<TFTCurveTable row="SlowPercent"/>%<keyword>緩速</>效果，持續<TFTCurveTable row="SlowDuration"/>秒。

<Rules>緩速：降低攻速</>
ability.descEn:
Tether the current target, dealing <TFTAttribute style="colorMagic" icon="icon.AP" attributeID="TFTCalculationAttributes.MagicDamageCalc1"/> magic damage over <TFTCurveTable row="TetherDuration"/> seconds. Then release a burst of power around them, dealing <TFTAttribute style="colorMagic" icon="icon.AP" attributeID="TFTCalculationAttributes.MagicDamageCalc2"/> magic damage to all enemies in a <TFTCurveTable row="AoEHexRange"/> Hex radius and <TFTCurveTable row="SlowPercent"/>% <keyword>Slowing</> them for <TFTCurveTable row="SlowDuration"/> seconds.

<Rules>Slow: Reduce Attack Speed</>

ability.descZh:
<Bright>被動：</>凱爾會依其星級飛昇，獲得可累加的加成。

<Bright>第一次飛昇：</>普攻造成<TFTAttribute style="colorMagic" icon="icon.AP" attributeID="TFTCalculationAttributes.MagicDamageCalc1"/>額外魔法傷害。
<Bright>第二次飛昇：</>普攻對命中的敵軍造成<TFTCurveTable row="ShredLevel"/>%<Keyword>削抗</>效果，持續<TFTCurveTable row="ShredDuration"/>秒。
<Bright>第三次飛昇：</>普攻發射波動，對所有其他命中的單位造成<TFTAttribute style="colorMagic" icon="icon.AP" attributeID="TFTCalculationAttributes.MagicDamageCalc2"/>魔法傷害。
<Bright>第四次飛昇</>：獲得無限攻擊距離。每<TFTCurveTable row="NumAttacksForBigWave4Star"/>波規模變大。

<Rules>削抗：降低魔防</>
ability.descEn:
<Bright>Passive:</> Kayle ascends based on her star level, granting her stacking bonuses. 

<Bright>1st Ascension:</> Attacks deal <TFTAttribute style="colorMagic" icon="icon.AP" attributeID="TFTCalculationAttributes.MagicDamageCalc1"/> bonus magic damage.
<Bright>2nd Ascension:</> Attacks <TFTCurveTable row="ShredLevel"/>% <Keyword>Shred</> enemies hit for <TFTCurveTable row="ShredDuration"/> seconds. 
<Bright>3rd Ascension:</> Attacks fire waves, dealing <TFTAttribute style="colorMagic" icon="icon.AP" attributeID="TFTCalculationAttributes.MagicDamageCalc2"/> magic damage to all other units hit.
<Bright>4th Ascension:</> Gain infinite range. Every <TFTCurveTable row="NumAttacksForBigWave4Star"/>rd wave is much larger.

<Rules>Shred: Reduce Magic Resist</>

ability.descZh:
蓄力準備，每有1位處於<Keyword>燃燒</>狀態的敵軍，增加<TFTCurveTable row="APPerBurningEnemy" format="percent" style="colorStat"/>魔攻。之後，獲得<TFTAttribute style="colorStat" icon="icon.AP" attributeID="TFTCalculationAttributes.ShieldCalc1"/>護盾，持續<TFTCurveTable row="ShieldDuration"/>秒，接著衝向附近的一群敵軍，對每個敵軍造成<TFTAttribute style="colorMagic" icon="icon.AP" attributeID="TFTCalculationAttributes.MagicDamageCalc1"/>魔法傷害。

衝刺後，釋放<TFTCurveTable row="FirestormHexRadius"/>格範圍的火焰風暴，在<TFTCurveTable row="FirestormDuration"/>秒內造成總計<TFTAttribute style="colorMagic" icon="icon.AP" attributeID="TFTCalculationAttributes.MagicDamageCalc2"/>魔法傷害，由所有命中的敵軍分攤。
ability.descEn:
Charge up, gaining <TFTCurveTable row="APPerBurningEnemy" format="percent" style="colorStat"/> Ability Power per <Keyword>Burning</> enemy. Then, gain <TFTAttribute style="colorStat" icon="icon.AP" attributeID="TFTCalculationAttributes.ShieldCalc1"/> Shield for <TFTCurveTable row="ShieldDuration"/> seconds and rush through a nearby group of enemies, dealing <TFTAttribute style="colorMagic" icon="icon.AP" attributeID="TFTCalculationAttributes.MagicDamageCalc1"/> magic damage to each. 

After rushing, unleash a <TFTCurveTable row="FirestormHexRadius"/> Hex firestorm that deals a total of <TFTAttribute style="colorMagic" icon="icon.AP" attributeID="TFTCalculationAttributes.MagicDamageCalc2"/> magic damage split among all enemies hit over <TFTCurveTable row="FirestormDuration"/> seconds.

ability.descZh: 衝向<TFTCurveTable row="LeapRangeHexes" precision="0"/>格內最遠的敵軍，造成<TFTAttribute style="colorMagic" icon="icon.AP" attributeID="TFTCalculationAttributes.MagicDamageCalc1"/>魔法傷害。若該敵軍沒有相鄰友軍，改為造成<TFTAttribute style="colorMagic" icon="icon.AP" attributeID="TFTCalculationAttributes.MagicDamageCalc2"/>魔法傷害，並獲得<TFTCurveTable row="IsolateManaGrant"/>魔力。{Augment.Variant.RivalsAugment.AbilityTooltip}
ability.descEn: Leap to the farthest enemy within <TFTCurveTable row="LeapRangeHexes" precision="0"/> Hexes, dealing <TFTAttribute style="colorMagic" icon="icon.AP" attributeID="TFTCalculationAttributes.MagicDamageCalc1"/> magic damage. If they have no adjacent allies, deal <TFTAttribute style="colorMagic" icon="icon.AP" attributeID="TFTCalculationAttributes.MagicDamageCalc2"/> magic damage instead and gain <TFTCurveTable row="IsolateManaGrant"/> mana.{Augment.Variant.RivalsAugment.AbilityTooltip}

ability.descZh: 在<TFTCurveTable row="Duration"/>秒內回復<TFTAttribute style="colorHealth" icon="icon.Health, icon.AP" attributeID="TFTCalculationAttributes.HealthCalc1"/>生命。下一次普攻替換為一記重擊，造成<TFTAttribute style="colorMagic" icon="icon.Health, icon.AP" attributeID="TFTCalculationAttributes.MagicDamageCalc1"/>魔法傷害。
ability.descEn: Restore <TFTAttribute style="colorHealth" icon="icon.Health, icon.AP" attributeID="TFTCalculationAttributes.HealthCalc1"/> Health over <TFTCurveTable row="Duration"/> seconds. The next attack is replaced with a bash that deals <TFTAttribute style="colorMagic" icon="icon.Health, icon.AP" attributeID="TFTCalculationAttributes.MagicDamageCalc1"/> magic damage.

ability.descZh:
<Bright>幻化者</><TFTAttribute style="colorPhysical" icon="icon.AD"/><Bright>：</>對目標及最靠近的另一名敵軍吐出酸液，造成<TFTAttribute style="colorPhysical" icon="icon.AD, icon.AP" attributeID="TFTCalculationAttributes.PhysicalDamageCalc1"/>物理傷害。對最大生命低於<TFTCurveTable row="ADBonusDamageThreshold" format="percent"/>的敵軍改為造成<TFTAttribute style="colorPhysical" icon="icon.AD, icon.AP" attributeID="TFTCalculationAttributes.PhysicalDamageCalc2"/>物理傷害。

<dim>幻化者</><TFTAttribute icon="icon.AP"/><dim>：對敵軍造成持續傷害。</>
ability.descEn:
<Bright>Adaptor</> <TFTAttribute style="colorPhysical" icon="icon.AD"/><Bright>:</> Launch acid at the target and the other nearest enemy, dealing <TFTAttribute style="colorPhysical" icon="icon.AD, icon.AP" attributeID="TFTCalculationAttributes.PhysicalDamageCalc1"/> physical damage. Enemies below <TFTCurveTable row="ADBonusDamageThreshold" format="percent"/> max Health take <TFTAttribute style="colorPhysical" icon="icon.AD, icon.AP" attributeID="TFTCalculationAttributes.PhysicalDamageCalc2"/> physical damage instead.

<dim>Adaptor</><TFTAttribute icon="icon.AP"/><dim>: Damages enemies over time.</>

ability.descZh:
<Bright>幻化者</><TFTAttribute style="colorMagic" icon=" icon.AP"/><Bright>：</>對目標及另一名最靠近敵軍吐出酸液，造成<TFTAttribute style="colorMagic" icon="icon.AP" attributeID="TFTCalculationAttributes.MagicDamageCalc1"/>魔法傷害，並在<TFTCurveTable row="APBonusDOTDuration"/>秒內額外造成<TFTAttribute style="colorMagic" icon="icon.AP" attributeID="TFTCalculationAttributes.MagicDamageCalc2"/>魔法傷害。

<dim>幻化者</><TFTAttribute icon="icon.AD"/><dim>：對低生命值的敵軍造成額外傷害。</>
ability.descEn:
<Bright>Adaptor </><TFTAttribute style="colorMagic" icon=" icon.AP"/><Bright>:</> Launch acid at the target and the other nearest enemy, dealing <TFTAttribute style="colorMagic" icon="icon.AP" attributeID="TFTCalculationAttributes.MagicDamageCalc1"/> magic damage and causing them to take an additional <TFTAttribute style="colorMagic" icon="icon.AP" attributeID="TFTCalculationAttributes.MagicDamageCalc2"/> magic damage over <TFTCurveTable row="APBonusDOTDuration"/> seconds.

<dim>Adaptor </><TFTAttribute icon="icon.AD"/><dim>: Deal bonus damage to enemies at low Health.</>

ability.descZh:
<Bright>被動：</>死亡時，分裂成兩隻擁有<TFTAttribute attributeID="TFTCalculationAttributes.HealthCalc1" style="colorStat" icon="icon.health"/>生命的小石怪，立即嘲諷敵軍攻擊自身。

<Bright>主動：</>增加<TFTAttribute attributeID="TFTCalculationAttributes.HealthCalc2" style="colorHealth" icon="icon.AP"/>最大生命，接著滾向目標，造成<TFTAttribute attributeID="TFTCalculationAttributes.PhysicalDamageCalc1" style="colorPhysical" icon="icon.AD,icon.health"/>傷害。

<TFTConditionalStyle tag="Set18.Trait.Riftbeast.Selected" activeStyle="bright" inactiveStyle="dim">石灰色增益：</><TFTConditionalStyle tag="Set18.Trait.Riftbeast.Selected" activeStyle="default" inactiveStyle="dim">死亡時，石怪與小石怪為友軍提供<TFTCurveTable row="TraitShieldHealth" format="percent"/>最大生命的護盾。</>
ability.descEn:
<Bright>Passive:</> On death, split into two Kruglettes with <TFTAttribute attributeID="TFTCalculationAttributes.HealthCalc1" style="colorStat" icon="icon.health"/> Health which immediately taunt, forcing enemies to attack them.

<Bright>Active:</> Gain <TFTAttribute attributeID="TFTCalculationAttributes.HealthCalc2" style="colorHealth" icon="icon.AP"/> max Health, then roll into the target, dealing <TFTAttribute attributeID="TFTCalculationAttributes.PhysicalDamageCalc1" style="colorPhysical" icon="icon.AD,icon.health"/> damage.

<TFTConditionalStyle tag="Set18.Trait.Riftbeast.Selected" activeStyle="bright" inactiveStyle="dim">Slate Buff:</> <TFTConditionalStyle tag="Set18.Trait.Riftbeast.Selected" activeStyle="default" inactiveStyle="dim">On death, Krug and Kruglettes Shield allies for <TFTCurveTable row="TraitShieldHealth" format="percent"/> max Health.</>

ability.descZh: 透過擊殺石怪生成。<rules>誰才是真正的怪物？</>
ability.descEn: Spawned by killing Krugs. <rules>Who's the real Monster?</>

ability.descZh:
<bright>被動：</>玩家戰鬥後，我方最強大的勒布朗有<TFTCurveTable row="PercentChanceToPrint" format="percent"/>機會生成我方盤面一名友軍的複製體，每次參與擊殺增加<TFTCurveTable row="PercentChanceToPrintKillBonus" format="percent"/>。

<bright>主動：</>派出鏡像攻擊目前的目標，造成<TFTAttribute style="colorMagic" icon="icon.AP" attributeID="TFTCalculationAttributes.MagicDamageCalc1"/>魔法傷害，對其相鄰敵軍造成<TFTAttribute style="colorMagic" icon="icon.AP" attributeID="TFTCalculationAttributes.MagicDamageCalc2"/>魔法傷害。
ability.descEn:
<bright>Passive:</> After player combat, your strongest LeBlanc has a <TFTCurveTable row="PercentChanceToPrint" format="percent"/> chance to create a copy of an ally on your board, increased by <TFTCurveTable row="PercentChanceToPrintKillBonus" format="percent"/> per takedown.

<bright>Active:</> Launch a mirror image at the current target, dealing <TFTAttribute style="colorMagic" icon="icon.AP" attributeID="TFTCalculationAttributes.MagicDamageCalc1"/> magic damage and <TFTAttribute style="colorMagic" icon="icon.AP" attributeID="TFTCalculationAttributes.MagicDamageCalc2"/> to adjacent enemies.

ability.descZh:
<Bright>被動：</>戰鬥開始時獲得<TFTAttribute style="colorStat" icon="icon.AP" attributeID="TFTCalculationAttributes.GenericCalc1"/> 額外雙防，在<TFTCurveTable row="DecayDuration"/>秒內逐漸衰減。

<Bright>主動：</>盾擊當前目標，造成<TFTAttribute style="colorMagic" icon="icon.Armor" attributeID="TFTCalculationAttributes.MagicDamageCalc1"/>魔法傷害，並使其暈眩<TFTCurveTable row="StunDuration"/>秒。
ability.descEn:
<Bright>Passive:</> Start combat with <TFTAttribute style="colorStat" icon="icon.AP" attributeID="TFTCalculationAttributes.GenericCalc1"/> bonus Armor and Magic Resist that decays over <TFTCurveTable row="DecayDuration"/> seconds.

<Bright>Active:</> Bash the current target, dealing <TFTAttribute style="colorMagic" icon="icon.Armor" attributeID="TFTCalculationAttributes.MagicDamageCalc1"/> magic damage and Stunning them for <TFTCurveTable row="StunDuration"/> seconds.

ability.descZh: 回復<TFTAttribute style="colorHealth" icon="icon.AP" attributeID="TFTCalculationAttributes.HealthCalc1"/>生命，並向附近敵軍釋放<TFTCurveTable row="NumEnemiesToFireAt"/>隻蝴蝶。命中的敵軍受到<TFTAttribute style="colorMagic" icon="icon.AP" attributeID="TFTCalculationAttributes.MagicDamageCalc1"/>魔法傷害，並使其沉睡<TFTCurveTable row="SleepDuration" style="Bright"/>秒。如果對方受到<TFTCurveTable row="DamageNeededToAwaken"/>傷害，會立刻醒來並額外受到最大生命<TFTCurveTable row="WakeupDamage" format="percent" style="colorMagic"/>的魔法傷害。
ability.descEn: Restore <TFTAttribute style="colorHealth" icon="icon.AP" attributeID="TFTCalculationAttributes.HealthCalc1"/> Health and send <TFTCurveTable row="NumEnemiesToFireAt"/> butterflies at nearby enemies. Enemies hit take <TFTAttribute style="colorMagic" icon="icon.AP" attributeID="TFTCalculationAttributes.MagicDamageCalc1"/> magic damage and Sleep for <TFTCurveTable row="SleepDuration" style="Bright"/> seconds. If they take <TFTCurveTable row="DamageNeededToAwaken"/> damage, they wake up and take an additional <TFTCurveTable row="WakeupDamage" format="percent" style="colorMagic"/> max Health magic damage.

ability.descZh:
<bright>被動：</>施放技能時，所有與拉克絲相同特性的友軍獲得<TFTAttribute attributeID="TFTCalculationAttributes.ManaCalc1" style="colorStat" icon="icon.AP"/>魔力。

<bright>主動：</>朝敵軍最密集處發射光束，造成<TFTAttribute attributeID="TFTCalculationAttributes.MagicDamageCalc1" style="colorMagic" icon="icon.AP"/>魔法傷害，每命中一名敵軍傷害降低<TFTCurveTable row="DamageReductionPerUnit" format="percent"/>。
ability.descEn:
<bright>Passive:</> On cast, all allies that share a trait with Lux gain <TFTAttribute attributeID="TFTCalculationAttributes.ManaCalc1" style="colorStat" icon="icon.AP"/> mana. 

<bright>Active:</> Fire a laser towards the largest group of enemies that deals <TFTAttribute attributeID="TFTCalculationAttributes.MagicDamageCalc1" style="colorMagic" icon="icon.AP"/> magic damage, reduced by <TFTCurveTable row="DamageReductionPerUnit" format="percent"/> for each enemy hit.

ability.descZh:
<bright>被動：</>施放技能時，與拉克絲擁有相同特性的友軍獲得<TFTAttribute attributeID="TFTCalculationAttributes.ManaCalc1" style="colorStat" icon="icon.AP"/>魔力。

<bright>主動：</>朝最多敵軍的直線發射光束，造成<TFTAttribute attributeID="TFTCalculationAttributes.MagicDamageCalc1" style="colorMagic" icon="icon.AP"/>魔法傷害，每命中一名敵軍，傷害降低<TFTCurveTable row="DamageReductionPerUnit" format="percent"/> (最低<TFTCurveTable row="MinimumFalloffDamageRatio" format="percent"/>)。

<bright>黑荊棘加成：</>暈眩命中的目標<TFTCurveTable row="BlackthornStunDuration"/>秒。
ability.descEn:
<bright>Passive:</> On cast, all allies that share a trait with Lux gain <TFTAttribute attributeID="TFTCalculationAttributes.ManaCalc1" style="colorStat" icon="icon.AP"/> mana. 

<bright>Active:</> Fire a laser towards the most enemies in a line that deals <TFTAttribute attributeID="TFTCalculationAttributes.MagicDamageCalc1" style="colorMagic" icon="icon.AP"/> magic damage, reduced by <TFTCurveTable row="DamageReductionPerUnit" format="percent"/> for each enemy hit (minimum <TFTCurveTable row="MinimumFalloffDamageRatio" format="percent"/>).

<bright>Blackthorn Bonus:</> Stuns targets hit for <TFTCurveTable row="BlackthornStunDuration"/> second.

ability.descZh:
<bright>被動：</>施放技能時，與拉克絲擁有相同特性的友軍獲得<TFTAttribute attributeID="TFTCalculationAttributes.ManaCalc1" style="colorStat" icon="icon.AP"/>魔力。

<bright>主動：</>朝最多敵軍的直線發射光束，造成<TFTAttribute attributeID="TFTCalculationAttributes.MagicDamageCalc1" style="colorMagic" icon="icon.AP"/>魔法傷害，每命中一名敵軍，傷害降低<TFTCurveTable row="DamageReductionPerUnit" format="percent"/> (最低<TFTCurveTable row="MinimumFalloffDamageRatio" format="percent"/>)。

<bright>盛放繁花加成：</>對第一個命中的目標造成<TFTCurveTable row="BlossomBonusDamageRatio" format="percent"/>額外傷害。
ability.descEn:
<bright>Passive:</> On cast, all allies that share a trait with Lux gain <TFTAttribute attributeID="TFTCalculationAttributes.ManaCalc1" style="colorStat" icon="icon.AP"/> mana. 

<bright>Active:</> Fire a laser towards the most enemies in a line that deals <TFTAttribute attributeID="TFTCalculationAttributes.MagicDamageCalc1" style="colorMagic" icon="icon.AP"/> magic damage, reduced by <TFTCurveTable row="DamageReductionPerUnit" format="percent"/> for each enemy hit (minimum <TFTCurveTable row="MinimumFalloffDamageRatio" format="percent"/>).

<bright>Blossom Bonus:</> The first target hit is dealt <TFTCurveTable row="BlossomBonusDamageRatio" format="percent"/> bonus damage.

<bright>Passive:</> Gain <TFTCurveTable row="Omnivamp" format="percent" style="colorStat"/> Omnivamp.

Then, spawn a <TFTCurveTable row="HexRangeAOE"/> Hex withering zone for the same duration that deals <TFTAttribute style="colorMagic" icon="icon.AP" attributeID="TFTCalculationAttributes.MagicDamageCalc2"/> magic damage per second. The next <TFTCurveTable row="NumEmpoweredAttacks"/> attacks gain <TFTCurveTable row="EmpowerAspd" format="PercentMinusOne"/> Attack Speed and deal <TFTAttribute style="colorPhysical" icon="icon.AD" attributeID="TFTCalculationAttributes.PhysicalDamageCalc2"/> bonus physical damage.

<Bright>Quest:</> Each player combat, Ornn stores damage blocked as Forge Power, increased by <TFTCurveTable row="DamageTaken3StarScalar" format="percentminusone"/> at 3-star. Gain an Artifact Anvil each time he gains enough Forge Power. <Rules>(Forge Power: </><TFTAttribute attributeID="TFTSpellAttributes.Stack" style="Rules"/><Rules> / </><TFTAttribute attributeID="TFTCalculationAttributes.GenericCalc1" style="Rules"/><Rules>)</>

朝目標發射光束，每秒消耗<TFTCurveTable row="PercentManaPerSecond" format="p"/>魔力。施放技能期間，每秒對目標造成<TFTAttribute style="colorMagic" icon="icon.AP" attributeID="TFTCalculationAttributes.MagicDamageCalc1"/>魔法傷害，且魔防降低<TFTCurveTable row="MRReduction"/>。

Begin consuming <TFTCurveTable row="PercentManaPerSecond" format="p"/> max Mana per second and channeling a laser on the target. Each second while casting, deal <TFTAttribute style="colorMagic" icon="icon.AP" attributeID="TFTCalculationAttributes.MagicDamageCalc1"/> magic damage to them and reduce their Magic Resist by <TFTCurveTable row="MRReduction"/>.

<TFTConditionalStyle tag="Set18.Trait.Riftbeast.Selected" activeStyle="Bright" inactiveStyle="dim">Teal Buff:</> <TFTConditionalStyle tag="Set18.Trait.Riftbeast.Selected" activeStyle="default" inactiveStyle="dim">Gain </><TFTConditionalStyle tag="Set18.Trait.Riftbeast.Selected" activeStyle="colorStat" inactiveStyle="dim"><TFTCurveTable row="TraitManaRegenTooltip"/></> <TFTConditionalStyle tag="Set18.Trait.Riftbeast.Selected" activeStyle="default" inactiveStyle="dim">Mana Regen for every <TFTCurveTable row="TraitChannelSecondsTooltip"/> seconds channeled.</>

legacy.descZh: 猛擊目標，造成<magicDamage>@ModifiedDamage@ (%i:scaleAP%)</magicDamage>魔法傷害。

ability.descZh: 被動：每有一名石怪友軍死亡時，生命治療至全滿。
ability.descEn: Passive: Heal to full Health whenever an allied Krug dies.

ability.descZh: 被動：戰鬥開始時，跳到敵軍後排。

ability.descZh: 被動：戰鬥開始時，跳到敵軍後排。

ability.descEn: Passive: Gain Attack Speed whenever an allied Razorbeak dies.

ability.descZh: 被動：每有一名巨喙鳥友軍死亡時，增加攻速。
ability.descEn: Passive: Gain Attack Speed whenever an allied Razorbeak dies.

ability.descZh: 戰鬥開始：向前衝刺，造成<magicDamage>@MaxHealthPct*100@%</magicDamage>最大生命的魔法傷害並使敵軍暈眩。
ability.descEn: Combat start: Charge forward, dealing <magicDamage>@MaxHealthPct*100@%</magicDamage> max Health magic damage and stunning enemies.

ability.descZh: 獲得<TFTAttribute style="colorStat" icon="icon.AP" attributeID="TFTCalculationAttributes.ShieldCalc1"/>護盾，持續<TFTCurveTable row="ShieldDuration"/>秒。然後賦予本場戰鬥造成最多傷害的友軍<TFTAttribute style="colorStat" icon="icon.AP" format="percentminusone" attributeID="TFTCalculationAttributes.AttackSpeedCalc1"/>攻速，在<TFTCurveTable row="AttackSpeedDuration"/>秒內衰減至失效。
ability.descEn: Gain <TFTAttribute style="colorStat" icon="icon.AP" attributeID="TFTCalculationAttributes.ShieldCalc1"/> Shield for <TFTCurveTable row="ShieldDuration"/> seconds. Then grant the ally who has dealt the most damage this combat <TFTAttribute style="colorStat" icon="icon.AP" format="percentminusone" attributeID="TFTCalculationAttributes.AttackSpeedCalc1"/> decaying Attack Speed for <TFTCurveTable row="AttackSpeedDuration"/> seconds.

ability.descZh:
嘲諷，迫使敵軍攻擊此英雄。在<TFTCurveTable row="Duration"/>秒內，獲得<TFTAttribute style="colorStat" icon="icon.AP" attributeID="TFTCalculationAttributes.ShieldCalc1"/>護盾以及<TFTCurveTable row="ArmorMR" style="colorStat"/>雙防。

護盾破裂時，對<TFTCurveTable row="DamageHexRange"/>格內的敵軍造成<TFTAttribute style="colorPhysical" icon="icon.Armor,icon.MR" attributeID="TFTCalculationAttributes.PhysicalDamageCalc1"/>物理傷害。
ability.descEn:
Taunt, forcing enemies to attack this champion. For <TFTCurveTable row="Duration"/> seconds, gain <TFTAttribute style="colorStat" icon="icon.AP" attributeID="TFTCalculationAttributes.ShieldCalc1"/> Shield and <TFTCurveTable row="ArmorMR" style="colorStat"/> Armor and Magic Resist.

When the Shield breaks, deal <TFTAttribute style="colorPhysical" icon="icon.Armor,icon.MR" attributeID="TFTCalculationAttributes.PhysicalDamageCalc1"/> physical damage to enemies in <TFTCurveTable row="DamageHexRange"/> Hexes.

ability.descZh:
<bright>被動：</>每秒恢復<TFTAttribute style="colorHealth" icon="icon.health" attributeID="TFTCalculationAttributes.HealthCalc2"/>生命，施放技能後<TFTCurveTable row="SpellMultiplierDuration"/>秒內恢復量提升為三倍。

<bright>主動：</>從地底衝出，暈眩相鄰敵軍<TFTCurveTable row="KnockupDuration"/>秒，並對其造成<TFTAttribute style="colorMagic" icon="icon.AP" attributeID="TFTCalculationAttributes.MagicDamageCalc1"/>魔法傷害。
ability.descEn:
<bright>Passive:</> Restore <TFTAttribute style="colorHealth" icon="icon.health" attributeID="TFTCalculationAttributes.HealthCalc2"/> Health each second, tripled for <TFTCurveTable row="SpellMultiplierDuration"/> seconds after casting.

<bright>Active:</> Lunge out of the ground, Stunning adjacent enemies for <TFTCurveTable row="KnockupDuration"/> second and dealing <TFTAttribute style="colorMagic" icon="icon.AP" attributeID="TFTCalculationAttributes.MagicDamageCalc1"/> magic damage to them.

ability.descZh: 跳向<TFTCurveTable row="JumpHexRange"/>格內生命百分比最低的敵軍並進行刺擊，造成<TFTAttribute style="colorPhysical" icon="icon.AD" attributeID="TFTCalculationAttributes.PhysicalDamageCalc1"/>物理傷害。隨後回復<TFTAttribute style="colorHealth" icon="icon.AP" attributeID="TFTCalculationAttributes.HealthCalc1"/>生命，根據目標已損失生命，治療量最多提升至<TFTAttribute style="colorHealth" icon="icon.AP" attributeID="TFTCalculationAttributes.HealthCalc2"/>生命。{Augment.Variant.RivalsAugment.AbilityTooltip}
ability.descEn: Jump to the lowest percent Health enemy within <TFTCurveTable row="JumpHexRange"/> hexes and stab them, dealing <TFTAttribute style="colorPhysical" icon="icon.AD" attributeID="TFTCalculationAttributes.PhysicalDamageCalc1"/> physical damage. Then heal for <TFTAttribute style="colorHealth" icon="icon.AP" attributeID="TFTCalculationAttributes.HealthCalc1"/>, increased to up to <TFTAttribute style="colorHealth" icon="icon.AP" attributeID="TFTCalculationAttributes.HealthCalc2"/> based on their missing Health.{Augment.Variant.RivalsAugment.AbilityTooltip}

ability.descZh:
<bright>被動：</>普攻將由舞蹈取代，對所有相鄰敵軍造成<TFTAttribute style="colorPhysical" icon="icon.ad" attributeID="TFTCalculationAttributes.PhysicalDamageCalc1"/>物理傷害。

<bright>主動：</>鑽入地底，增加<TFTCurveTable style="colorStat" row="BurrowDurability" format="percent"/>續戰力，持續<TFTCurveTable row="BurrowDuration"/>秒，在持續時間內回復<TFTAttribute style="colorHealth" icon="icon.ap" attributeID="TFTCalculationAttributes.HealthCalc1"/>生命。

<TFTConditionalStyle tag="Set18.Trait.Riftbeast.Selected" activeStyle="bright" inactiveStyle="dim">綠色增益：</><TFTConditionalStyle tag="Set18.Trait.Riftbeast.Selected" activeStyle="default" inactiveStyle="dim">友軍生命低於<TFTCurveTable row="TraitHealthThreshold" format="percent"/>時，回復</><TFTConditionalStyle tag="Set18.Trait.Riftbeast.Selected" activeStyle="colorStat" inactiveStyle="dim"><TFTCurveTable row="TraitPercentHeal" format="percent"/></><TFTConditionalStyle tag="Set18.Trait.Riftbeast.Selected" activeStyle="default" inactiveStyle="dim">最大生命。</>
ability.descEn:
<bright>Passive:</> Attacks are replaced by a dance that deals <TFTAttribute style="colorPhysical" icon="icon.ad" attributeID="TFTCalculationAttributes.PhysicalDamageCalc1"/> physical damage to all adjacent enemies.

<bright>Active:</> Burrow underground, gaining <TFTCurveTable style="colorStat" row="BurrowDurability" format="percent"/> Durability for <TFTCurveTable row="BurrowDuration"/> seconds and healing <TFTAttribute style="colorHealth" icon="icon.ap" attributeID="TFTCalculationAttributes.HealthCalc1"/> over the duration. 

<TFTConditionalStyle tag="Set18.Trait.Riftbeast.Selected" activeStyle="bright" inactiveStyle="dim">Green Buff:</> <TFTConditionalStyle tag="Set18.Trait.Riftbeast.Selected" activeStyle="default" inactiveStyle="dim">When allies fall below <TFTCurveTable row="TraitHealthThreshold" format="percent"/> Health, they restore </><TFTConditionalStyle tag="Set18.Trait.Riftbeast.Selected" activeStyle="colorStat" inactiveStyle="dim"><TFTCurveTable row="TraitPercentHeal" format="percent"/></><TFTConditionalStyle tag="Set18.Trait.Riftbeast.Selected" activeStyle="default" inactiveStyle="dim"> max Health.</>

ability.descZh: 獲得<TFTAttribute style="colorStat" icon="icon.Health, icon.AP" attributeID="TFTCalculationAttributes.ShieldCalc1"/>護盾，持續<TFTCurveTable row="ShieldDuration"/>秒。隨後以扇形範圍劈砍，造成<TFTAttribute style="colorMagic" icon="icon.AP" attributeID="TFTCalculationAttributes.MagicDamageCalc1"/>魔法傷害，再施展直線斬擊，對命中的敵軍造成<TFTAttribute style="colorMagic" icon="icon.AP" attributeID="TFTCalculationAttributes.MagicDamageCalc2"/>魔法傷害。
ability.descEn: Gain <TFTAttribute style="colorStat" icon="icon.Health, icon.AP" attributeID="TFTCalculationAttributes.ShieldCalc1"/> Shield for <TFTCurveTable row="ShieldDuration"/> seconds. Then cleave in a cone, dealing <TFTAttribute style="colorMagic" icon="icon.AP" attributeID="TFTCalculationAttributes.MagicDamageCalc1"/> magic damage and strike in a line, dealing <TFTAttribute style="colorMagic" icon="icon.AP" attributeID="TFTCalculationAttributes.MagicDamageCalc2"/> magic damage to enemies hit.

ability.descZh:
獲得<TFTAttribute style="colorStat" icon="icon.AP,icon.health" attributeID="TFTCalculationAttributes.ShieldCalc1"/>護盾，持續<TFTCurveTable row="ShieldDuration"/>秒。猛擊地面，朝著最多敵軍的方向形成一條裂隙。短暫擊飛命中的敵軍，造成<TFTAttribute style="colorMagic" icon="icon.AP" attributeID="TFTCalculationAttributes.MagicDamageCalc1"/>魔法傷害，以及持續<TFTCurveTable row="ManaReaveFlat"/>的<keyword>魔力掠奪</>效果。

<TFTConditionalStyle tag="Set18.Trait.Riftbeast.Selected" activeStyle="bright" inactiveStyle="dim">藍色增益：</><TFTConditionalStyle tag="Set18.Trait.Riftbeast.Selected" activeStyle="default" inactiveStyle="dim">守望者施放技能時，友軍獲得</><TFTConditionalStyle tag="Set18.Trait.Riftbeast.Selected" activeStyle="colorStat" inactiveStyle="dim"><TFTCurveTable row="TraitAlliesManaRegen"/></><TFTConditionalStyle tag="Set18.Trait.Riftbeast.Selected" activeStyle="default" inactiveStyle="dim">魔力回復</>

<rules>魔力掠奪：下次施放技能所需的魔力增加。</>
ability.descEn:
Gain <TFTAttribute style="colorStat" icon="icon.AP,icon.health" attributeID="TFTCalculationAttributes.ShieldCalc1"/> Shield for <TFTCurveTable row="ShieldDuration"/> seconds. Slam the ground, sending a fissure in the direction of the most enemies. Enemies hit are briefly knocked up, take <TFTAttribute style="colorMagic" icon="icon.AP" attributeID="TFTCalculationAttributes.MagicDamageCalc1"/> magic damage, and are <keyword>Mana Reaved</> for <TFTCurveTable row="ManaReaveFlat"/>.

<TFTConditionalStyle tag="Set18.Trait.Riftbeast.Selected" activeStyle="bright" inactiveStyle="dim">Blue Buff:</> <TFTConditionalStyle tag="Set18.Trait.Riftbeast.Selected" activeStyle="default" inactiveStyle="dim">Each time Sentinel casts, allies gain</> <TFTConditionalStyle tag="Set18.Trait.Riftbeast.Selected" activeStyle="colorStat" inactiveStyle="dim"><TFTCurveTable row="TraitAlliesManaRegen"/></> <TFTConditionalStyle tag="Set18.Trait.Riftbeast.Selected" activeStyle="default" inactiveStyle="dim">Mana Regen.</>

<rules>Mana Reave: Increase the Mana cost of the next Ability cast.</>

ability.descZh:
<Bright>被動：</>每場戰鬥首次低於<TFTCurveTable row="ManaHPThreshold" format="percent"/>最大生命時，獲得100魔力。

<Bright>主動：</>蓄力準備揮出重拳，迅速回復<TFTAttribute style="colorHealth" icon="icon.Health, icon.AP" attributeID="TFTCalculationAttributes.HealthCalc1"/>生命，然後對大扇形範圍造成<TFTAttribute style="colorPhysical" icon="icon.Health, icon.AD" attributeID="TFTCalculationAttributes.PhysicalDamageCalc1"/>物理傷害。
ability.descEn:
<Bright>Passive:</> Upon falling below <TFTCurveTable row="ManaHPThreshold" format="percent"/> max Health the first time each combat, gain 100 mana.

<Bright>Active:</> Wind up a big punch, rapidly healing for <TFTAttribute style="colorHealth" icon="icon.Health, icon.AP" attributeID="TFTCalculationAttributes.HealthCalc1"/> before dealing <TFTAttribute style="colorPhysical" icon="icon.Health, icon.AD" attributeID="TFTCalculationAttributes.PhysicalDamageCalc1"/> physical damage in a large cone.

ability.descZh: 賦予慎<TFTAttribute style="colorStat" icon="icon.AP" attributeID="TFTCalculationAttributes.ShieldCalc1"/>護盾，賦予鄰近一名受傷友軍<TFTAttribute style="colorStat" icon="icon.AP" attributeID="TFTCalculationAttributes.ShieldCalc2"/>護盾，持續<TFTCurveTable row="MagicShieldDuration"/>秒。兩者接下來的<TFTCurveTable row="NumAttacksBuff"/>次普攻獲得<TFTCurveTable style="colorStat" row="AttackSpeedBuff" format="percent"/>攻速，並造成<TFTAttribute style="colorMagic" icon="icon.AP" attributeID="TFTCalculationAttributes.MagicDamageCalc1"/>額外魔法傷害。
ability.descEn: Grant <TFTAttribute style="colorStat" icon="icon.AP" attributeID="TFTCalculationAttributes.ShieldCalc1"/> Shield to Shen and <TFTAttribute style="colorStat" icon="icon.AP" attributeID="TFTCalculationAttributes.ShieldCalc2"/> Shield to a nearby damaged ally for <TFTCurveTable row="MagicShieldDuration"/> seconds. Both of their next <TFTCurveTable row="NumAttacksBuff"/> attacks gain <TFTCurveTable style="colorStat" row="AttackSpeedBuff" format="percent"/> Attack Speed and deal <TFTAttribute style="colorMagic" icon="icon.AP" attributeID="TFTCalculationAttributes.MagicDamageCalc1"/> bonus magic damage.

ability.descZh: 擲出一把巨大的十字刃，對當前目標造成<TFTAttribute attributeId="TFTCalculationAttributes.PhysicalDamageCalc1" style="colorPhysical" icon="Icon.AD, Icon.AP"/>物理傷害，並在鄰近敵軍間彈跳<TFTCurveTable row="NumBounces"/>次，每次彈跳造成<TFTAttribute attributeId="TFTCalculationAttributes.PhysicalDamageCalc2" style="colorPhysical" icon="Icon.AD, Icon.AP"/>物理傷害。此效果擊殺敵軍時，額外彈跳<TFTCurveTable row="BonusKillBounces"/>次。
ability.descEn: Throw a large crossblade that deals <TFTAttribute attributeId="TFTCalculationAttributes.PhysicalDamageCalc1" style="colorPhysical" icon="Icon.AD, Icon.AP"/> physical damage to the current target and bounces <TFTCurveTable row="NumBounces"/> times between nearby enemies, dealing <TFTAttribute attributeId="TFTCalculationAttributes.PhysicalDamageCalc2" style="colorPhysical" icon="Icon.AD, Icon.AP"/> physical damage each bounce. When this kills an enemy, bounce <TFTCurveTable row="BonusKillBounces"/> additional times.

ability.descZh: 召喚殞星墜落在目前的目標身上，造成<TFTAttribute style="colorMagic" icon="icon.AP" attributeID="TFTCalculationAttributes.MagicDamageCalc1"/>魔法傷害。如果目前之前曾被殞星擊中，召喚<TFTCurveTable row="NumAdditionalStars"/>顆額外殞星，每顆造成<TFTAttribute style="colorMagic" icon="icon.AP" attributeID="TFTCalculationAttributes.MagicDamageCalc2"/>魔法傷害。
ability.descEn: Call down a star on the current target, dealing <TFTAttribute style="colorMagic" icon="icon.AP" attributeID="TFTCalculationAttributes.MagicDamageCalc1"/> magic damage. If a star has previously fallen on them, call down <TFTCurveTable row="NumAdditionalStars"/> additional stars that each deal <TFTAttribute style="colorMagic" icon="icon.AP" attributeID="TFTCalculationAttributes.MagicDamageCalc2"/> magic damage.

SprykinSummonMelee.zh: 將百戰老兵拖曳至毛茸茸大夥伴上方並停住，即可將其設為騎乘者！
SprykinSummonMelee.en: Drag a Sprykin over BFF and hold to set them as the rider!

ability.descZh: 咆哮，為騎乘者回復其最大生命<TFTAttribute style="colorHealth" format="percent" attributeID="TFTCalculationAttributes.HealthCalc1"/>的生命。
ability.descEn: Roar, healing the Rider for <TFTAttribute style="colorHealth" format="percent" attributeID="TFTCalculationAttributes.HealthCalc1"/> of their maximum Health.

SprykinSummonRanged.zh: 將百戰老兵拖曳至毛茸茸大夥伴上方並按住，即可將其設為騎乘者！
SprykinSummonRanged.en: Drag a Sprykin over BFF and hold to set them as the rider!

ability.descZh: 起舞，賦予騎乘者<TFTCurveTable format="percent" row="ADandAP"/>物攻與魔攻，持續到戰鬥結束。
ability.descEn: Dance, granting the Rider <TFTCurveTable format="percent" row="ADandAP"/> Attack Damage and Ability Power for the rest of combat.

ability.descZh:
<Bright>被動：</>塔里克或其搭檔生命首次低於<TFTCurveTable row="PassivePercentHealthThreshold" format="percent"/>時，兩者都會發出深綠色的能量，使<TFTCurveTable row="PassiveHexRadius"/>格內的友軍獲得<TFTAttribute style="colorStat" icon="icon.Health" attributeID="TFTCalculationAttributes.ShieldCalc1"/>護盾，持續<TFTCurveTable row="PassiveShieldDuration"/>秒。

<Bright>主動：</>回復<TFTAttribute style="colorHealth" icon="icon.AP" attributeID="TFTCalculationAttributes.HealthCalc1"/>生命。塔里克和其搭檔友軍接下來<TFTCurveTable row="NumAttacks"/>次普攻會造成<TFTAttribute style="colorMagic" icon="icon.AP" attributeID="TFTCalculationAttributes.MagicDamageCalc1"/>額外魔法傷害。
ability.descEn:
<Bright>Passive:</> The first time Taric or his paired ally drops below <TFTCurveTable row="PassivePercentHealthThreshold" format="percent"/> Health, unleash emerald energy from both of them, granting <TFTAttribute style="colorStat" icon="icon.Health" attributeID="TFTCalculationAttributes.ShieldCalc1"/> Shield to allies within <TFTCurveTable row="PassiveHexRadius"/> Hexes for <TFTCurveTable row="PassiveShieldDuration"/> seconds.

<Bright>Active:</> Restore <TFTAttribute style="colorHealth" icon="icon.AP" attributeID="TFTCalculationAttributes.HealthCalc1"/> Health. Taric and his paired ally deal <TFTAttribute style="colorMagic" icon="icon.AP" attributeID="TFTCalculationAttributes.MagicDamageCalc1"/> bonus magic damage on their next <TFTCurveTable row="NumAttacks"/> attacks.

ability.descZh:
投擲2朵蘑菇，對最靠近的<TFTCurveTable row="NumEnemiesHit"/>名敵軍造成<TFTAttribute style="colorMagic" icon="icon.AP" attributeID="TFTCalculationAttributes.MagicDamageCalc1"/>魔法傷害。之後投擲巨型蘑菇，對目標造成<TFTAttribute style="colorMagic" icon="icon.AP" attributeID="TFTCalculationAttributes.MagicDamageCalc2"/>魔法傷害。

每次施放時，有<TFTCurveTable row="PercentChanceOfForage" format="percent"/>機會額外採集1朵蘑菇，收集可以獲得加成效果。

<bright>紅色：</><TFTCurveTable row="RedRerolls"/>重抽<Rules>(已採集紅色蘑菇：</><TFTAttribute attributeID="TFTSpellAttributes.Stack" style="Rules"/><Rules>)</>
<bright>綠色：</><TFTCurveTable row="GreenHealth"/>棋手生命<Rules>(已採集綠色蘑菇：</><TFTAttribute style="rules" attributeID="TFTCalculationAttributes.GenericCalc1"/><Rules>)</>
<bright>黃色：</><TFTCurveTable row="YellowXP"/>經驗值<Rules>(已採集黃色蘑菇：</><TFTAttribute style="rules" attributeID="TFTCalculationAttributes.GenericCalc2"/><Rules>)</>
ability.descEn:
Throw 2 clusters of mushrooms that deal <TFTAttribute style="colorMagic" icon="icon.AP" attributeID="TFTCalculationAttributes.MagicDamageCalc1"/> magic damage to the <TFTCurveTable row="NumEnemiesHit"/> nearest enemies. Then hurl a giant mushroom that deals <TFTAttribute style="colorMagic" icon="icon.AP" attributeID="TFTCalculationAttributes.MagicDamageCalc2"/> magic damage to the target.

Each cast has a <TFTCurveTable row="PercentChanceOfForage" format="percent"/> chance to forage an extra mushroom that can be collected for bonus effects.

<bright>Red:</> <TFTCurveTable row="RedRerolls"/> Reroll  <Rules>(Reds Foraged: </><TFTAttribute attributeID="TFTSpellAttributes.Stack" style="Rules"/><Rules>)</>
<bright>Green:</> <TFTCurveTable row="GreenHealth"/> Tactician Health <Rules>(Greens Foraged:</> <TFTAttribute style="rules" attributeID="TFTCalculationAttributes.GenericCalc1"/><Rules>)</>
<bright>Yellow:</> <TFTCurveTable row="YellowXP"/> XP <Rules>(Yellows Foraged:</> <TFTAttribute style="rules" attributeID="TFTCalculationAttributes.GenericCalc2"/><Rules>)</>

ability.descZh: 每<TFTCurveTable row="TowerAttackInterval"/>秒，對最靠近的<TFTCurveTable row="TowerNumTargets"/>名敵軍造成<TFTCurveTable format="percent" row="MaxHealthDamageMultiplier"/>最大生命的真實傷害。
ability.descEn: Every <TFTCurveTable row="TowerAttackInterval"/> seconds, deal <TFTCurveTable format="percent" row="MaxHealthDamageMultiplier"/> max Health true damage to the <TFTCurveTable row="TowerNumTargets"/> nearest enemies.

ability.descZh: 訓練假人無法移動或攻擊。它還穿得像是一位英俊到爆的約德爾人。
ability.descEn: The Training Dummy cannot move or attack. It is also dressed like a devilishly handsome Yordle.

legacy.descEn: The Training Dummy cannot move or attack. It is also dressed like a devilishly handsome Yordle.
legacy.descZh: 訓練假人無法移動或攻擊。它還穿得像是一位英俊到爆的約德爾人。

ability.descZh:
在目標上附著一枚爆炸射擊，持續<TFTCurveTable row="Duration"/>秒。啟動時，獲得無限攻擊距離和<TFTAttribute style="colorStat" icon="icon.AP" attributeID="TFTCalculationAttributes.AttackSpeedCalc1" format="p"/>攻速。持續時間結束後，射擊會爆炸，並將傷害分攤給2格內的所有敵軍，造成<TFTAttribute style="colorPhysical" icon="icon.AD" attributeID="TFTCalculationAttributes.PhysicalDamageCalc1"/>物理傷害，並且每次施放攻擊時額外造成<TFTAttribute style="colorPhysical" icon="icon.AD" attributeID="TFTCalculationAttributes.PhysicalDamageCalc2"/>傷害。

<Rules>如果身上有爆炸射擊的敵軍死亡，爆炸射擊會轉移到崔絲塔娜的新目標身上。</>
ability.descEn:
Attach an explosive charge to the target that lasts <TFTCurveTable row="Duration"/> seconds. While active, gain infinite range and <TFTAttribute style="colorStat" icon="icon.AP" attributeID="TFTCalculationAttributes.AttackSpeedCalc1" format="p"/> Attack Speed. After the duration, the charge explodes and splits damage between all enemies within 2 hexes, dealing <TFTAttribute style="colorPhysical" icon="icon.AD" attributeID="TFTCalculationAttributes.PhysicalDamageCalc1"/> physical damage + <TFTAttribute style="colorPhysical" icon="icon.AD" attributeID="TFTCalculationAttributes.PhysicalDamageCalc2"/> for each attack while casting.

<Rules>If an enemy with an explosive charge on them dies, it attaches to Tristana's new target.</>

ability.descZh: 蓄力後，朝包含目標在內最多敵軍的直線射出一支箭。對命中的敵軍造成<TFTAttribute style="colorPhysical" icon="icon.AD, icon.AP" attributeID="TFTCalculationAttributes.PhysicalDamageCalc1"/>物理傷害，每穿過一名敵軍傷害減少<TFTCurveTable row="DamageReductionPerHit" format="percent"/>(最低<TFTCurveTable row="MinDamagePercent" format="percent"/>)。
ability.descEn: Wind up, then fire an arrow at the most enemies in line with the target. It deals <TFTAttribute style="colorPhysical" icon="icon.AD, icon.AP" attributeID="TFTCalculationAttributes.PhysicalDamageCalc1"/> physical damage to enemies hit, reduced by <TFTCurveTable row="DamageReductionPerHit" format="percent"/> for each enemy it passes through (minimum <TFTCurveTable row="MinDamagePercent" format="percent"/>).

ability.descZh:
向目標發射巨大能量波，造成<TFTAttribute style="colorMagic" icon="icon.AP" attributeID="TFTCalculationAttributes.MagicDamageCalc1"/>魔法傷害，若目標低於<TFTCurveTable row="HPThreshold" format="percent"/>最大生命，傷害提升至<TFTAttribute style="colorMagic" icon="icon.AP" attributeID="TFTCalculationAttributes.MagicDamageCalc2"/>。

若目標死亡，永久獲得<TFTCurveTable row="APOnKill"/>%魔攻。

當前加成：<TFTAttribute attributeID="TFTSpellAttributes.Stack" precision="0"/>% <TFTAttribute parens="false" icon="Icon.AP"/>
ability.descEn:
Launch a giant blast at the target that deals <TFTAttribute style="colorMagic" icon="icon.AP" attributeID="TFTCalculationAttributes.MagicDamageCalc1"/> magic damage, increased to <TFTAttribute style="colorMagic" icon="icon.AP" attributeID="TFTCalculationAttributes.MagicDamageCalc2"/> if they're below <TFTCurveTable row="HPThreshold" format="percent"/> max Health.

If they die, permanently gain <TFTCurveTable row="APOnKill"/>% Ability Power.

Current bonus: <TFTAttribute attributeID="TFTSpellAttributes.Stack" precision="0"/>% <TFTAttribute parens="false" icon="Icon.AP"/>

ability.descZh:
<bright>被動：</>普攻時回復<TFTAttribute style="colorHealth" icon="icon.Health" attributeID="TFTCalculationAttributes.HealthCalc1"/>生命。

<bright>主動：</>發出野性狂吼，回復<TFTAttribute style="colorHealth" icon="icon.AP" attributeID="TFTCalculationAttributes.HealthCalc3"/>生命。隨後增加<TFTCurveTable style="colorStat" row="SpellAS" format="percentminusone"/>攻速、<TFTCurveTable style="colorStat" row="SpellDurability" format="percent"/>續戰力，並進入無人能擋狀態<TFTCurveTable row="SpellDuration"/>秒。
ability.descEn:
<bright>Passive:</> On attack, restore <TFTAttribute style="colorHealth" icon="icon.Health" attributeID="TFTCalculationAttributes.HealthCalc1"/> Health.

<bright>Active:</> Unleash a primal roar, restoring <TFTAttribute style="colorHealth" icon="icon.AP" attributeID="TFTCalculationAttributes.HealthCalc3"/> Health. Then gain <TFTCurveTable style="colorStat" row="SpellAS" format="percentminusone"/> Attack Speed, <TFTCurveTable style="colorStat" row="SpellDurability" format="percent"/> Durability, and is unstoppable for <TFTCurveTable row="SpellDuration"/> seconds.

ability.descZh: 嚙咬當前目標，造成<TFTAttribute style="colorPhysical" icon="icon.AD" attributeID="TFTCalculationAttributes.PhysicalDamageCalc1"/>物理傷害，並回復相當於所造成傷害<TFTAttribute attributeID="TFTCalculationAttributes.GenericCalc1" style="colorHealth" icon="icon.AP" format="percent"/>的生命。增加<TFTCurveTable row="AttackSpeedBuff" format="percentMinusOne" style="colorStat"/>攻速，持續到戰鬥結束。
ability.descEn: Bite the current target, dealing <TFTAttribute style="colorPhysical" icon="icon.AD" attributeID="TFTCalculationAttributes.PhysicalDamageCalc1"/> physical damage and healing for <TFTAttribute attributeID="TFTCalculationAttributes.GenericCalc1" style="colorHealth" icon="icon.AP" format="percent"/> of the damage dealt. Gain <TFTCurveTable row="AttackSpeedBuff" format="percentMinusOne" style="colorStat"/> Attack Speed for the rest of combat.

ability.descZh: 接下來<TFTCurveTable row="NumAttacks"/>次普攻獲得<TFTCurveTable row="AttackSpeed" style="colorStat" format="percentMinusOne"/>攻速。強化普攻化作羽毛，造成<TFTAttribute style="colorPhysical" icon="icon.AD" attributeID="TFTCalculationAttributes.PhysicalDamageCalc1"/>物理傷害並使物防降低<TFTAttribute icon="icon.AP" attributeID="TFTCalculationAttributes.GenericCalc1" style="colorStat"/>。
ability.descEn: Gain <TFTCurveTable row="AttackSpeed" style="colorStat" format="percentMinusOne"/> Attack Speed for the next <TFTCurveTable row="NumAttacks"/> attacks. These attacks are replaced with feathers that deal <TFTAttribute style="colorPhysical" icon="icon.AD" attributeID="TFTCalculationAttributes.PhysicalDamageCalc1"/> physical damage and reduce Armor by <TFTAttribute icon="icon.AP" attributeID="TFTCalculationAttributes.GenericCalc1" style="colorStat"/>.

ability.descZh:
<Bright>被動：</>死亡時，生成最大生命為<TFTAttribute icon="icon.Health" attributeID="TFTCalculationAttributes.HealthCalc2" style="colorStat"/>的神靈行者，立即嘲諷敵軍攻擊自身。

<Bright>主動：</>回復<TFTAttribute style="colorHealth" icon="icon.AP" attributeID="TFTCalculationAttributes.HealthCalc1"/>生命，並打擊目標，造成<TFTAttribute style="colorPhysical" icon="icon.AD" attributeID="TFTCalculationAttributes.PhysicalDamageCalc1"/>物理傷害。
ability.descEn:
<Bright>Passive:</> On death, spawn a Spirit Walker with <TFTAttribute icon="icon.Health" attributeID="TFTCalculationAttributes.HealthCalc2" style="colorStat"/> max Health which immediately taunts, forcing enemies to attack it.

<Bright>Active:</> Restore <TFTAttribute style="colorHealth" icon="icon.AP" attributeID="TFTCalculationAttributes.HealthCalc1"/> Health and strike the target, dealing <TFTAttribute style="colorPhysical" icon="icon.AD" attributeID="TFTCalculationAttributes.PhysicalDamageCalc1"/> physical damage.

ability.descZh: 這個亡魂從約瑞科的墳墓跳出來，一心只知道攻擊。
ability.descEn: This Spirit sprang forth from Yorick's grave, it only knows how to attack.

ability.descZh: 向前衝刺，對當前目標發射念珠，造成<TFTAttribute style="colorPhysical" icon="icon.AD, Icon.AP" attributeID="TFTCalculationAttributes.PhysicalDamageCalc1"/>物理傷害。接著，念珠會分裂，對<TFTCurveTable row="NumSecondaryTargets"/>名鄰近敵軍造成<TFTAttribute style="colorPhysical" icon="icon.AD,icon.AP" attributeID="TFTCalculationAttributes.PhysicalDamageCalc2"/>物理傷害。
ability.descEn: Dash, then launch an orb at the current target that deals <TFTAttribute style="colorPhysical" icon="icon.AD, Icon.AP" attributeID="TFTCalculationAttributes.PhysicalDamageCalc1"/> physical damage and splits, dealing <TFTAttribute style="colorPhysical" icon="icon.AD,icon.AP" attributeID="TFTCalculationAttributes.PhysicalDamageCalc2"/> physical damage to <TFTCurveTable row="NumSecondaryTargets"/> nearby enemies.

ability.descZh: 在戰場上四處召喚<TFTCurveTable row="NumPlantsToSpawn"/>株植物，普攻最靠近的敵軍<TFTCurveTable row="ThornSpitterNumAttacks"/>次。每次普攻造成<TFTAttribute style="colorMagic" icon="icon.AP" attributeID="TFTCalculationAttributes.MagicDamageCalc1"/>魔法傷害。
ability.descEn: Spawn <TFTCurveTable row="NumPlantsToSpawn"/> plants around the battlefield that attack the nearest enemy <TFTCurveTable row="ThornSpitterNumAttacks"/> times. Each attack deals <TFTAttribute style="colorMagic" icon="icon.AP" attributeID="TFTCalculationAttributes.MagicDamageCalc1"/> magic damage.

Adaptor.descZh:
<bright>天生：</>幻化者的技能會根據其物攻或是魔攻較高而改變。

幻化者會根據何者較高而增加魔攻或物攻。
Adaptor.descEn:
<bright>Innate:</> Adaptor abilities change depending on if their Attack Damage or Ability Power is higher.

Adaptors gain Ability Power or Attack Damage, depending on which is higher.

ApexPredator.descZh: 遠古巨龍會占用<colorStat>2</>個隊伍人口，並使峽谷巨獸特性+<colorStat>2</>。
ApexPredator.descEn: Elder Dragon takes up <colorStat>2</> team slots and grants +<colorStat>2</> to the Riftbeast trait.

Attuned.descZh: 我方最強大的亞盧妮在每次施放技能後進入新的月相。當月亮為半月或更小時，我方隊伍增加<TFTCurveTable row="Durability" format="invertedPercent"/>續戰力。若月亮更大，我方隊伍獲得<TFTCurveTable row="DamageAmp" format="percent"/>傷害增幅。{Set18.Unit.Alune.CombatSpacer}{Set18.Unit.Alune.Phase}
Attuned.descEn: Your strongest Alune cycles to a new phase of the moon after each cast. While the moon is at or below half full, your team gains <TFTCurveTable row="Durability" format="invertedPercent"/> Durabilty. While above, your team gains <TFTCurveTable row="DamageAmp" format="percent"/> Damage Amp.{Set18.Unit.Alune.CombatSpacer}{Set18.Unit.Alune.Phase}

Avatar.descZh:
備戰區或盤面上有1名聖靈使時，商店中所有其他聖靈使的特性都轉化為與該聖靈使相同。

聖靈使所選擇的特性算作兩次特性加成。
Avatar.descEn:
Having an Avatar on your bench or board transforms all other Avatars in your shop to the Trait of that Avatar.

An Avatar's chosen Trait is counted twice for Trait bonuses.

Blossom.descZh:
戰鬥結束後，你的神火獲得強化。

盛放繁花英雄獲得物攻、魔攻與<TFTCurveTable row="BonusHealth" format="PercentMinusOne" column="1"/>最大生命。
Blossom.descEn:
After combat, your Wisps are empowered. 

Blossom champions gain Attack Damage, Ability Power, and <TFTCurveTable row="BonusHealth" format="PercentMinusOne" column="1"/> max Health.

BountySeeker.descZh:
選擇賞金。我方最強大的達瑞文可以推進賞金進度來獲得獎勵。完成賞金後，可選擇另一個。

{TraitTags.DravenUniqueTrait.BountyDescription}{TraitTags.DravenUniqueTrait.Tracker}
BountySeeker.descEn:
Choose a bounty. Your strongest Draven can progress on the bounty to earn its reward. Upon completing a bounty, choose another.

{TraitTags.DravenUniqueTrait.BountyDescription}{TraitTags.DravenUniqueTrait.Tracker}

Brawler.descZh: 我方隊伍增加<TFTCurveTable row="BrawlerTeamHealth" column="1"/>最大生命。武鬥家獲得更多。
Brawler.descEn: Your team gains <TFTCurveTable row="BrawlerTeamHealth" column="1"/> max Health. Brawlers gain more.

Caustic.descZh:
腐蝕傷害會對敵軍造成<TFTCurveTable row="ShredPercent" column="1"/>%削抗和破甲，持續<TFTCurveTable row="ShredDuration"/>秒。

<rules>削抗：降低魔防</>
<Rules>破甲：降低物防</>
Caustic.descEn:
Caustic damage <TFTCurveTable row="ShredPercent" column="1"/>% Shreds and Sunders enemies for <TFTCurveTable row="ShredDuration"/> seconds.

<rules>Shred: Reduce Magic Resist</>
<Rules>Sunder: Reduce Armor</>

Coven.descZh:
透過擊殺英雄來收集精華，輸掉玩家戰鬥還能獲得更多。

累積<TFTCurveTable row="EssenceForRitualTooltip" column="1"/>精華時，可選擇將精華轉換為獎勵，或繼續收集精華。每項獎勵所需的精華量會逐漸增加。
Coven.descEn:
Gather Essence by killing champions, plus more by losing player combat. 

Beginning at <TFTCurveTable row="EssenceForRitualTooltip" column="1"/> Essence, choose to convert Essence to rewards or continue gathering Essence. Each reward requires increasing amounts of Essence.

Defender.descZh: 我方隊伍增加<TFTCurveTable row="NonDefenderDefenseGain" column="1"/>雙防。捍衛者獲得更多。
Defender.descEn: Your team gains <TFTCurveTable row="NonDefenderDefenseGain" column="1"/> Armor and Magic Resist. Defenders gain more.

Eclipse.descZh: 在<TFTCurveTable row="DelaySeconds"/>秒戰鬥後，日蝕會擊殺生命最低的敵軍，每隔<TFTCurveTable row="EclipseBeamPeriod"/>秒重複一次。
Eclipse.descEn: After <TFTCurveTable row="DelaySeconds"/> seconds of combat, the Eclipse kills the lowest Health enemy, repeating every <TFTCurveTable row="EclipseBeamPeriod"/> seconds.

Elderwood.descZh: 獲得可放置的神木精靈植物。

EmeraldAspect.descZh: 將一名友軍拖曳到我方最強大的塔里克身上組成搭檔，該友軍可以獲得塔里克技能的強大加成。
EmeraldAspect.descEn: Drag an ally onto your strongest Taric to pair them, granting the ally powerful bonuses from Taric's Ability.

Fae.descZh:
我方隊伍造成的傷害、治療和護盾會吸引皮克斯。

每隻皮克斯會賦予妖精英雄物攻和魔攻，當他們的生命低於<TFTCurveTable row="HealThreshold" format="percent"/>時，會為每隻皮克斯回復生命。
Fae.descEn:
Your team's damage, healing, and shielding attracts Pixies.

Each Pixie grants Fae champions Attack Damage and Ability Power, and after they fall below <TFTCurveTable row="HealThreshold" format="percent"/> Health, they heal for each Pixie.

FloraFatalis.descZh: 絕命花華英雄參與擊殺時會收割目標，獲得：
FloraFatalis.descEn: Flora Fatalis champions harvest enemies on takedown, gaining:

Hunter.descZh: 獵手增加物攻。如果獵手連續<TFTCurveTable row="HunterDuration" column="1"/>秒沒有更換目標，會獲得<TFTCurveTable row="DamageAmp" column="1" format="percent"/>傷害增幅。
Hunter.descEn: Hunters gain Attack Damage. If a Hunter hasn't swapped targets for <TFTCurveTable row="HunterDuration" column="1"/> seconds, they gain <TFTCurveTable row="DamageAmp" column="1" format="percent"/> Damage Amp.

Inferno.descZh: 地獄火使者造成的傷害會<keyword>燃燒</>並<keyword>重創</>敵軍<TFTCurveTable row="Duration" column="1"/>秒。地獄火使者燃燒會與其他燃燒效果疊加。
Inferno.descEn: Inferno damage <keyword>Burns</> and <keyword>Wounds</> enemies for <TFTCurveTable row="Duration" column="1"/> seconds. Inferno Burns stack with other Burns.

Invoker.descZh: 我方隊伍獲得魔力回復，神諭者獲得更多。
Invoker.descEn: Your team gains Mana Regen, increased for Invokers.

Juggernaut.descZh: 我方隊伍增加續戰力。重裝戰士獲得更多。
Juggernaut.descEn: Your team gains Durability. Juggernauts gain more.

Lunar.descZh: 月華英雄與相鄰友軍會獲得攻速和魔攻。月華英雄額外獲得<TFTCurveTable row="LunarMultiplier" format="percentMinusOne"/>加成。
Lunar.descEn: Lunar champions and adjacent allies gain Attack Speed and Ability Power. Lunar champions gain <TFTCurveTable row="LunarMultiplier" format="percentMinusOne"/> more.

Monolith.descZh: 每有一位敵軍以巨岩壁壘為目標，便增加<TFTCurveTable row="Resists"/>雙防。
Monolith.descEn: Monoliths gain <TFTCurveTable row="Resists"/> Armor and Magic Resist for each enemy targeting them.

OldGrowth.descZh:
每當有敵軍在<TFTCurveTable row="UniqueTraitHexRange"/>格內死亡，我方最強大的原始林英雄獲得<TFTCurveTable row="UniqueTraitHealthPerStack"/>永久最大生命。

目前：<TFTAttribute attributeId="TFTCalculationAttributes.GenericCalc1"/>
OldGrowth.descEn:
Whenever an enemy within <TFTCurveTable row="UniqueTraitHexRange"/> hexes dies, your strongest Old Growth champion gains <TFTCurveTable row="UniqueTraitHealthPerStack"/> permanent max Health.

Current: <TFTAttribute attributeId="TFTCalculationAttributes.GenericCalc1"/>

Primal.descZh: 在四大野性祝福中選擇一項。
Primal.descEn: Choose one of four Primal Blessings.

Rapidfire.descZh: 我方隊伍增加<TFTCurveTable row="TeamAS" column="1" format="percentMinusOne"/>攻速。速射英雄每次普攻可獲得更多加成，最多累加<TFTCurveTable row="MaxStacks"/>層。
Rapidfire.descEn: Your team gains <TFTCurveTable row="TeamAS" column="1" format="percentMinusOne"/> Attack Speed. Rapidfire champions gain more on every attack, up to <TFTCurveTable row="MaxStacks"/> stacks.

Ravager.descZh: 劫肆者獲得<TFTCurveTable row="Omnivamp" column="1" format="percent"/>全能吸血。此外，劫肆者能造成額外傷害，對生命在<TFTCurveTable row="EnemyHealthThreshold" column="1" format="percent"/>以下的單位造成兩倍傷害。
Ravager.descEn: Ravagers gain <TFTCurveTable row="Omnivamp" column="1" format="percent"/> Omnivamp. Additionally, Ravagers deal bonus damage, doubled against units below <TFTCurveTable row="EnemyHealthThreshold" column="1" format="percent"/> Health.

Spellweaver.descZh: 我方隊伍增加<TFTCurveTable row="TeamwideAP" column="1" format="percent"/>魔攻。術士增加更多魔攻，且每當一位術士施放技能時，所有術士都會額外獲得魔攻。
Spellweaver.descEn: Your team gains <TFTCurveTable row="TeamwideAP" column="1" format="percent"/> Ability Power. Spellweavers gain more, plus extra Ability Power whenever a Spellweaver casts an Ability.

Sprykin.descZh: 獲得毛茸茸大夥伴。將百戰老兵放到毛茸茸大夥伴上來選擇騎乘者。
Sprykin.descEn: Gain the Big Furry Friend. Drop a Sprykin on the BFF to pick its Rider.

Summoner.descZh:
喚物大師會用不同方式強化其召喚物。

約瑞科：+<TFTCurveTable row="HealthMult" column="1" format="percentMinusOne"/>生命
阿祈爾：+<TFTCurveTable row="AzirDamageMult" column="1" format="percentMinusOne"/>傷害
巨喙鳥媽媽：+<TFTCurveTable row="DamageMult" column="1" format="percentMinusOne"/>傷害
枷蘿：+<TFTCurveTable row="NumExtraAttacks" column="1"/>次植物攻擊
Summoner.descEn:
Summoners empower their summons in different ways.

Yorick: +<TFTCurveTable row="HealthMult" column="1" format="percentMinusOne"/> Health
Azir: +<TFTCurveTable row="AzirDamageMult" column="1" format="percentMinusOne"/> Damage
Mama Beak: +<TFTCurveTable row="DamageMult" column="1" format="percentMinusOne"/> Damage
Zyra: +<TFTCurveTable row="NumExtraAttacks" column="1"/> Plant Attacks

Thornmaiden.descZh: 我方隊伍增加<TFTCurveTable row="BaseDurability" column="1" format="invertedPercent"/>續戰力，若枷蘿的植物存活<TFTCurveTable row="PlantNumThreshold" column="1"/>株以上，增加到<TFTCurveTable row="IncreasedDurability" column="1" format="invertedPercent"/>。
Thornmaiden.descEn: Your team gains <TFTCurveTable row="BaseDurability" column="1" format="invertedPercent"/> Durability, increased to <TFTCurveTable row="IncreasedDurability" column="1" format="invertedPercent"/> if <TFTCurveTable row="PlantNumThreshold" column="1"/> or more Zyra plants are alive.
